JAN 2026 — PRESENTCHAMPAIGN, IL

NLP Engineer

School of Information Sciences, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

  • Fine-tuned PubMedBERT on imbalanced biomedical literature and achieved 91% F1 for identifying clinical-trial sample-size sentences.
  • Improved minority-class detection by 18% through targeted resampling and custom weighted-loss functions, reducing bias across underrepresented clinical populations.
  • Built a few-shot BioMistral workflow that converts biomedical passages into structured sample-size records for downstream analysis.
  • Optimized inference on an NVIDIA H200 NVL with FP8 quantization and KV-cache optimization, increasing throughput by 31%.
  • Developed a token-level named-entity recognition model for extracting participant counts from unstructured papers, reaching 89% token accuracy.
